title.narrative: Funguo Innovation Program and Facility: Phase I

description.narrative: Funguo is designed to lay the foundation for and unlock the potential of Tanzanian innovators and entrepreneurs to create Impact Ventures at scale. The overall objective of the program is that Impact Ventures contribute to the achievement of the national development goals and the SDGs in Tanzania by supporting the creation of more Impact Ventures (with a focus on women and youth lead ventures) to scale. In particular, the program will work on (i) access to 3rd party finance for portfolio Impact Ventures, (ii) am supporting Business Development Service providers (BDS) in the Innovation Ecosystem to generate more investment ready and scalable Impact Ventures, and (iii) improving the Enabling Environment for women and youth lead innovation ventures.

title.narrative: of stakeholders that have adopted new policies, strategies, projects or programs related to innovative entrepreneurship in Tanzania, influenced by the program (disaggregate with / without direct consultations)

description.narrative: of stakeholders that have adopted new policies, strategies, projects or programs related to innovative entrepreneurship in Tanzania, influenced by the program (disaggregate with / without direct consultations)This indicator measures the influence of the FUNGUO Programme to other stakeholders interventions in the innovation and startup ecosystem.

comment.narrative: 1. Tanzania Industrial Research Development Organization TIRDO Embedded innovation management in their activities and dedicated space which was repurposed as an innovation hub THUB to support and incubate techstartups. The process was supported by FUNGUO funding. 2. Capital Markets and Securities Authority CMSA Drafted Crowdfunding Guidelines a process supported by FUNGUO.3. Tanzania Commission for Science and Technology COSTECH Spearheaded the review of Science Technology and Innovation Policy drafted the Tanzania Innovation Ecosystem Management Framework and initiated a programme to support women in tech FemTech through its innovation Hub BUNI HUB. FUNGUO greatly contributed to all these initiatives. 4. Information and Communications Technology Commission ICTC Started the process of establishing a space for ICT Startups refined the Tanzania Annual ICT Conference to make it a policy dialogue platform and a marketplace for tech startups to connect with potential investors. FUNGUO supported the two initiatives. 5. Bank of Tanzania Drafted the FINTECH Regulatory Sandbox Regulations indirectly influenced by FUNGUO through various strategic dialogues. 6. Swiss Embassy Launched the Innovation for Social Change programme which has a component of catalytic funding for social enterprises through the Daraja Impact Fund. This programme started with the Swiss Embassy engagement in the inception process of the FUNGUO programme.

description.narrative: of stakeholders that have adopted new policies, strategies, projects or programs related to innovative entrepreneurship in Tanzania, influenced by the program (disaggregate with / without direct consultations)This indicator measures the influence of the FUNGUO Programme to other stakeholders interventions in the innovation and startup ecosystem.

comment.narrative: 1. Tanzania Industrial Research Development Organization TIRDO Embedded innovation management in their activities and dedicated space which was repurposed as an innovation hub THUB to support and incubate techstartups. The process was supported by FUNGUO funding. 2. Capital Markets and Securities Authority CMSA Drafted Crowdfunding Guidelines a process supported by FUNGUO.3. Tanzania Commission for Science and Technology COSTECH Spearheaded the review of Science Technology and Innovation Policy drafted the Tanzania Innovation Ecosystem Management Framework and initiated a programme to support women in tech FemTech through its innovation Hub BUNI HUB. FUNGUO greatly contributed to all these initiatives. 4. Information and Communications Technology Commission ICTC Started the process of establishing a space for ICT Startups refined the Tanzania Annual ICT Conference to make it a policy dialogue platform and a marketplace for tech startups to connect with potential investors. FUNGUO supported the two initiatives. 5. Bank of Tanzania Drafted the FINTECH Regulatory Sandbox Regulations indirectly influenced by FUNGUO through various strategic dialogues. 6. Swiss Embassy Launched the Innovation for Social Change programme which has a component of catalytic funding for social enterprises through the Daraja Impact Fund. This programme started with the Swiss Embassy engagement in the inception process of the FUNGUO programme.
